headline: Approved $101,060 for Leftfield OPM services and invoices totaling $288,316.21 for DPW Garage Project; GMP of about $43 million construction cost expected by end of August
summary: The Committee on Infrastructure and Board of Public Works received a progress update on the DPW Garage Project, including design, permitting, and construction cost estimates of about $43 million. The board approved invoices for Leftfield and HKT Architects, and approved $101,060 for continued Owner's Project Manager services from Leftfield. The group also discussed scheduling a future meeting on October 22, 2026, and a possible joint meeting in late September to approve the Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP).
decisions: Approved the minutes of the May 28, 2026 meeting.
Approved invoices for Leftfield services (#193097, $15,000; #195343, $15,000) and HKT Architects (#0010-022442, $258,316.21), with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved $101,060 for Leftfield's Owner's Project Manager (OPM) services for Phase III, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
